guide.label: Administrative forest code
guide.text: Administrative forest code. A code indicating the administrative unit (Forest Service Region and National Forest) in which the condition is located.

guide.label: Administratively withdrawn code
guide.text: Administratively withdrawn code. (core optional) A code indicating whether or not a condition has an administratively withdrawn designation.

guide.label: Current afforestation code
guide.text: Current afforestation code. A code indicating a condition that has no evidence of prior forest, but does have evidence suggesting deliberate afforestation attempts (planted or prepared to promote tree establishment) to convert to forest in the current inventory cycle or since the last measurement.

guide.label: Age basis code, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Age basis code, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code that indicates the method used to determine stand age.

guide.label: All-live-tree stocking percent
guide.text: All-live-tree stocking percent. The sum of stocking percent values of all live trees, including seedlings, on the condition.

plain.label: All-live stocking
plain.help: Stocking percent of all live trees and seedlings, as reported by FIA.

guide.label: All live stocking code
guide.text: All live stocking code. A code indicating the stocking of the condition by live trees, including seedlings.

guide.label: Condition aspect
guide.text: Condition aspect. The aspect across the condition to the nearest 1 degree.

plain.label: Aspect
plain.help: Direction the slope faces, in degrees.

guide.label: Basal area per acre of live trees
guide.text: Basal area per acre of live trees. Basal area in square feet per acre of all live trees ≥1.0 inc h d.b.h./d.r.c. sampled in the condition.

plain.label: Live basal area
plain.help: Basal area per acre of live trees ≥1.0 in in the condition, as computed by FIA.

guide.label: Canopy cover sample method code
guide.text: Canopy cover sample method code. A code indicating the canopy cover sample method used to determine LIVE_CANOPY_CVR_PCT, LIVE_MISSING_CANOPY_CVR_PCT, and NBR_LIVE_STEMS. Codes 1-4 are used for field-measured canopy cover, and codes 11-14 are generated from imagery.

guide.label: Carbon in down dead
guide.text: Carbon in down dead. Carbon, in tons per acre, of woody material >3 inches in diameter on the ground, and stumps and their roots >3 inches in diameter.

guide.label: Carbon in litter
guide.text: Carbon in litter. Carbon, in tons per acre, of organic material on the floor of the forest, including fine woody debris, humus, and fine roots in the organic forest floor layer above mineral soil.

guide.label: Carbon in soil organic material
guide.text: Carbon in soil organic material. Carbon, in tons per acre, in fine organic material below the soil surface to a depth of 1 meter.

guide.label: Carbon in understory aboveground
guide.text: Carbon in understory aboveground. Carbon, in tons per acre, in the aboveground portions of seedlings and woody shrubs.

guide.label: Carbon in understory belowground
guide.text: Carbon in understory belowground. Carbon, in tons per acre, in the belowground portions of seedlings and woody shrubs.

guide.label: Chaining code
guide.text: Chaining code. A code indicating that a condition has been chained, shear bladed, roller chopped, etc., for the purpose of increased forage production.

guide.label: Sequence number
guide.text: Sequence number. A unique sequence number used to identify a condition record.

guide.label: Condition class number
guide.text: Condition class number. Unique identifying number assigned to each condition on a plot.

plain.label: Condition
plain.help: Condition number on the plot.

guide.label: Condition proportion unadjusted
guide.text: Condition proportion unadjusted. The unadjusted proportion of the plot that is in the condition.

plain.label: Share of plot
plain.help: Share of the plot area in this condition (0–1), before any adjustment.

guide.label: Condition nonsampled reason code
guide.text: Condition nonsampled reason code. A code indicating the reason a condition class was not sampled.

guide.label: Condition status code
guide.text: Condition status code. A code indicating the basic land classification.

plain.label: Land status
plain.help: Whether the condition is accessible forest land, nonforest land, water, or could not be sampled.

guide.label: Condition class status change code, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Condition class status change code, Rocky Mountain Research Station. A code that describes the type of change that has occurred for the condition class since the previous inventory.

guide.label: County code
guide.text: County code. The identification number for a county, parish, watershed, borough, or similar governmental unit in a State.

guide.label: Live crown cover percent, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Live crown cover percent, Rocky Mountain Research Station. The percentage of live crown cover, to the nearest 1 percent, of all established tally seedlings, saplings, and trees.

guide.label: Created by
guide.text: Created by. See SURVEY.CREATED_BY description for definition.

guide.label: Created date
guide.text: Created date. See SURVEY.CREATED_DATE description for definition.

guide.label: Created in instance
guide.text: Created in instance. See SURVEY.CREATED_IN_INSTANCE description for definition.

guide.label: Inventory cycle number
guide.text: Inventory cycle number. See SURVEY.CYCLE description for definition.

guide.label: Dominant tree species 1 (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Dominant tree species 1 (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code corresponding to the tree species with the plurality of cover for all live trees in the condition class that are not overtopped.

guide.label: Dominant tree species 2 (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Dominant tree species 2 (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code for the second most abundant tree species in each condition class.

guide.label: Dominant tree species 3 (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Dominant tree species 3 (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code for the third most abundant tree species in each condition class.

guide.label: Disturbance code 1
guide.text: Disturbance code 1. A code indicating the kind of disturbance occurring since the last measurement or within the last 5 years for new plots.

plain.label: Disturbance 1
plain.help: Kind of disturbance since the last measurement (insects, disease, fire, animals, weather, vegetation, human, …).

guide.label: Disturbance code 1, periodic to annual
guide.text: Disturbance code 1, periodic to annual. A code indicating the kind of disturbance occurring since the last measurement.

guide.label: Disturbance code 2
guide.text: Disturbance code 2. The second disturbance code, if the stand has experienced more than one disturbance.

plain.label: Disturbance 2
plain.help: Kind of disturbance since the last measurement (insects, disease, fire, animals, weather, vegetation, human, …).

guide.label: Disturbance code 2, periodic to annual
guide.text: Disturbance code 2, periodic to annual. The second disturbance code, if the stand has experienced more than one disturbance.

guide.label: Disturbance code 3
guide.text: Disturbance code 3. The third disturbance code, if the stand has experienced more than two disturbances.

plain.label: Disturbance 3
plain.help: Kind of disturbance since the last measurement (insects, disease, fire, animals, weather, vegetation, human, …).

guide.label: Disturbance code 3, periodic to annual
guide.text: Disturbance code 3, periodic to annual. The third disturbance code, if the stand has experienced more than two disturbances.

guide.label: Disturbance year 1
guide.text: Disturbance year 1. The year in which disturbance 1 (DSTRBCD1) is estimated to have occurred.

plain.label: Disturbance 1 year
plain.help: Year the disturbance happened (or was first noticed).

guide.label: Disturbance year 1, periodic to annual
guide.text: Disturbance year 1, periodic to annual. The year in which disturbance 1 (DSTRBCD1_P2A) is estimated to have occurred.

guide.label: Disturbance year 2
guide.text: Disturbance year 2. The year in which disturbance 2 (DSTRBCD2) occurred.

plain.label: Disturbance 2 year
plain.help: Year the disturbance happened (or was first noticed).

guide.label: Disturbance year 2, periodic to annual
guide.text: Disturbance year 2, periodic to annual. The year in which disturbance 2 (DSTRBCD2_P2A) is estimated to have occurred.

guide.label: Disturbance year 3
guide.text: Disturbance year 3. The year in which disturbance 3 (DSTRBCD3) occurred.

plain.label: Disturbance 3 year
plain.help: Year the disturbance happened (or was first noticed).

guide.label: Disturbance year 3, periodic to annual
guide.text: Disturbance year 3, periodic to annual. The year in which disturbance 3 (DSTRBCD3_P2A) is estimated to have occurred.

guide.label: DWM condition fuelbed type code
guide.text: DWM condition fuelbed type code. A code indicating the fuels available for consumption by fire.

guide.label: Fire, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Fire, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the presence or absence of fire on the condition since the last survey or within the last 5 years on new/replacement plots.

guide.label: Field-recorded stand age
guide.text: Field-recorded stand age. The stand age as assigned by the field crew.

plain.label: Field stand age
plain.help: Stand age recorded by the field crew.

guide.label: Field stand-size class code
guide.text: Field stand-size class code. A code indicating the field-assigned classification of the predominant (based on stocking) diameter class of live trees within the condition.

plain.label: Field stand size
plain.help: Stand size class assigned by the field crew.

guide.label: Field forest type code
guide.text: Field forest type code. A code indicating the forest type, assigned by the field crew, based on the tree species or species groups forming a plurality of all live stocking.

plain.label: Field forest type
plain.help: Forest type assigned by the field crew.

guide.label: Field forest type code, version 3.0
guide.text: Field forest type code, version 3.0. Forest type codes when PLOT.MANUAL <4.0, assigned by the field crew, based on the tree species or species groups forming a plurality of all live stocking.

guide.label: Forest type (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Forest type (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code indicating the forest type that best describes the species with the plurality of crown cover for all live trees in the condition class that are not overtopped.

guide.label: Forest land condition status change code
guide.text: Forest land condition status change code. A code indicating the reason why the forest land condition status changed since the last inventory.

guide.label: Forest type code
guide.text: Forest type code. This is the forest type used for reporting purposes.

plain.label: Forest type
plain.help: Forest type used for reporting, based on the tree species with the most stocking.

guide.label: Forest type code calculated
guide.text: Forest type code calculated. Forest type is calculated based on the tree species sampled on the condition.

plain.label: Computed forest type
plain.help: Forest type computed from the tree data by the FIA algorithm.

guide.label: Grazing, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Grazing, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the presence or absence of domestic animal grazing on the condition since the last survey or within the last 5 years on new/replacement plots.

guide.label: Present ground land class, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Present ground land class, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code indicating a ground land class (GLC) category, which is used to further refine the forest land classification for the condition.

guide.label: Growing-stock stocking percent
guide.text: Growing-stock stocking percent. The sum of stocking percent values of all growing-stock trees and seedlings on the condition.

plain.label: Growing-stock stocking
plain.help: Stocking percent of growing-stock trees and seedlings, as reported by FIA.

guide.label: Growing-stock stocking code
guide.text: Growing-stock stocking code. A code indicating the stocking of the condition by growing-stock trees and seedlings.

guide.label: Habitat type code 1
guide.text: Habitat type code 1. A code indicating the primary habitat type (or community type) for this condition.

guide.label: Habitat type code 1 description publication code
guide.text: Habitat type code 1 description publication code. A code indicating the publication that gives a description for habitat type code 1 (HABTYPCD1).

guide.label: Habitat type code 1 publication code
guide.text: Habitat type code 1 publication code. A code indicating the publication that lists the name for habitat type code 1 (HABTYPCD1).

guide.label: Habitat type code 2
guide.text: Habitat type code 2. A code indicating the secondary habitat type (or community type) for this condition.

guide.label: Habitat type code 2 description publication code
guide.text: Habitat type code 2 description publication code. A code indicating the publication that gives a description for habitat type code 2 (HABTYPCD2).

guide.label: Habitat type code 2 publication code
guide.text: Habitat type code 2 publication code. A code indicating the publication that lists the name for habitat type code 2 (HABTYPCD2).

guide.label: Harvest type code 1, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Harvest type code 1, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the harvest type.

guide.label: Harvest type code 2, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Harvest type code 2, Southern Research Station. See HARVEST_TYPE1_SRS.

guide.label: Harvest type code 3, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Harvest type code 3, Southern Research Station. See HARVEST_TYPE1_SRS.

guide.label: Industrial code in FIADB
guide.text: Industrial code in FIADB. A code indicating the status of the owner with regard to their objectives towards commercial timber production. This attribute is new starting with FIADB version 6.0 (PLOT.MANUAL ≥6.0).

guide.label: Inventory year
guide.text: Inventory year. See SURVEY.INVYR description for definition.

guide.label: Land cover class code
guide.text: Land cover class code. A code indicating the type of cover for a condition that meets the minimum area and width requirements, except those with cases where the condition has been defined due to one of the exceptions to the size and width requirements.

guide.label: Land cover class, retired
guide.text: Land cover class, retired. A code indicating the type of land cover for a condition that meets the minimum area and width requirements (except those cases where the condition has been solely defined due to developed land uses, such as roads and rights-of-way).

guide.label: Land use code, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Land use code, Rocky Mountain Research Station. A code indicating the current land use for an accessible forest land or nonforest land condition class.

guide.label: Land use, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Land use, Southern Research Station. A classification indicating the present land use of the condition.

guide.label: Live canopy cover percent
guide.text: Live canopy cover percent. The percentage of live canopy cover for the condition.

guide.label: Live plus missing canopy cover percent
guide.text: Live plus missing canopy cover percent. The percentage of live and missing canopy cover for the condition.

guide.label: Macroplot proportion unadjusted
guide.text: Macroplot proportion unadjusted. The unadjusted proportion of the macroplots that are in the condition.

guide.label: Mean annual increment cubic feet
guide.text: Mean annual increment cubic feet. A measure of the productivity of forest land for the condition expressed as the average increase in cubic feet of (growing stock) wood volume per acre per year occurring in the year that mean annual increment (MAI) culminates (peaks), in fully stocked natural stands.

guide.label: Mapping density
guide.text: Mapping density. A code indicating the relative tree density of the condition.

guide.label: Microplot proportion unadjusted
guide.text: Microplot proportion unadjusted. The unadjusted proportion of the microplots that are in the condition.

guide.label: Mixed conifer code
guide.text: Mixed conifer code. An indicator to show that the forest condition is a mixed conifer site in California.

guide.label: Modified by
guide.text: Modified by. See SURVEY.MODIFIED_BY description for definition.

guide.label: Modified date
guide.text: Modified date. See SURVEY.MODIFIED_DATE description for definition.

guide.label: Modified in instance
guide.text: Modified in instance. See SURVEY.MODIFIED_IN_INSTANCE description for definition.

guide.label: Microquadrat proportion unadjusted
guide.text: Microquadrat proportion unadjusted. The unadjusted proportion of the microquadrats that are in the condition.

guide.label: Number of live stems
guide.text: Number of live stems. The estimated number of live stems per acre on the condition.

guide.label: D Nonforest condition nonsampled reason code NUMBER(2)
guide.text: D Nonforest condition nonsampled reason code NUMBER(2)

guide.label: Nonforest condition nonsampled reason code
guide.text: Nonforest condition nonsampled reason code. A code indicating the reason a nonforest portion of a plot was not sampled. 4 Year-round water problems (includes islands). 5 Slopes 20-40 percent. 6 Slope greater than 40 percent.

guide.label: Nonforest condition status code
guide.text: Nonforest condition status code. A code indicating the sampling status of the condition class.

guide.label: Level 1 code of the NVCS
guide.text: Level 1 code of the NVCS. The NVCS code describing the vegetative community of the condition at the first level of the NVCS hierarchy. It is populated for both the 'NATURAL' and 'CULTURAL' primary classifications.

guide.label: Level 2 code of the NVCS
guide.text: Level 2 code of the NVCS. The NVCS code describing the vegetative community of the condition at the second level of the NVCS hierarchy. It is populated for both the 'NATURAL' and 'CULTURAL' primary classifications.

guide.label: Level 3 code of the NVCS
guide.text: Level 3 code of the NVCS. The NVCS code describing the vegetative community of the condition at the third level of the NVCS hierarchy. It is populated for both the 'NATURAL' and 'CULTURAL' primary classifications.

guide.label: Level 4 code of the NVCS
guide.text: Level 4 code of the NVCS. The NVCS code describing the vegetative community of the condition at the fourth level of the NVCS hierarchy. It is populated for both the 'NATURAL' and 'CULTURAL' primary classifications.

guide.label: L evel 5 code of the NVCS
guide.text: Level 5 code of the NVCS. The NVCS code describing the vegetative community of the condition at the fifth level of the NVCS hierarchy. It is populated for both the 'NATURAL' and 'CULTURAL' primary classifications.

guide.label: Level 6 code of the NVCS
guide.text: Level 6 code of the NVCS. The NVCS code describing the vegetative community of the condition at the sixth level of the NVCS hierarchy. It is populated for the 'CULTURAL' primary classification.

guide.label: Level 7 code of the NVCS
guide.text: Level 7 code of the NVCS. The NVCS code describing the vegetative community of the condition at the seventh level of the NVCS hierarchy. It is populated for the 'CULTURAL' primary classification.

guide.label: Level 8 code of the NVCS
guide.text: Level 8 code of the NVCS. The NVCS code describing the vegetative community of the condition at the eighth level of the NVCS hierarchy. It is populated for the 'CULTURAL' primary classification.

guide.label: Primary class
guide.text: Primary class. The primary classification determined by the NVCS classification algorithm. 'NATURAL' or 'CULTURAL' are the valid values.

guide.label: Operability, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Operability, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the viability of operating logging equipment in the vicinity of the condition.

guide.label: Owner class code
guide.text: Owner class code. (core for all accessible forest land; core optional for other sampled land) A code indicating the ownership category of the land for the condition.

plain.label: Owner class
plain.help: Detailed ownership class of the land in the condition.

guide.label: Owner group code
guide.text: Owner group code. (core for all accessible forest land; core optional for other sampled land) A code indicating the ownership group of the land for the condition.

plain.label: Owner group
plain.help: Broad ownership group: Forest Service, other federal, state and local government, or private.

guide.label: Owner subclass code
guide.text: Owner subclass code. (core optional for accessible forest land) A code that further subdivides the owner class into detailed subcategories.

guide.label: Physiographic class code
guide.text: Physiographic class code. A code indicating the general effect of land form, topographical position, and soil on moisture available to trees.

plain.label: Physiographic class
plain.help: Landform and moisture class, e.g., dry slopes, moist flatwoods, floodplains.

guide.text: NW Plant stockability factor, Pacific North west Research Station NUMBER 2.5.82 STND_COND_CD_PNWRS Stand condition code, Pacific Northwest Research Station NUMBER(1) 2.5.83 STND_STRUC_CD_PNWRS Stand structure code, Pacific North west Research Station NUMBER(1) 2.5.84 STUMP_CD_PNWRS Stump code, Pacific Northwest…

guide.label: Plant stockability factor, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Plant stockability factor, Pacific Northwest Research Station. Some plots in PNWRS have forest land condition classes that are low productivity sites, and are incapable of attaining normal yield table levels of stocking.

guide.label: Plot number
guide.text: Plot number. An identifier for a plot.

guide.label: Plot sequence number
guide.text: Plot sequence number. Foreign key linking the condition record to the plot record.

guide.label: Present nonforest code
guide.text: Present nonforest code. A code indicating the current land use for a nonforest condition, which meets the minimum area and width requirements (except those cases where the condition has been solely defined due to developed land uses, such as roads and rights-of-way).

guide.label: Previous afforestation code
guide.text: Previous afforestation code. A code indicating a condition that has no evidence of prior forest, but does have evidence suggesting deliberate afforestation attempts (planted or prepared to promote tree establishment) to convert to forest in the prior inventory cycle or prior to the last measurement.

guide.label: Proportion basis
guide.text: Proportion basis. A value indicating what type of fixed-size subplots were installed when this plot was sampled.

guide.label: Quadratic mean diameter, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Quadratic mean diameter, Rocky Mountain Research Station. The quadratic mean diameter, or the diameter of the tree of average basal area, on the condition.

guide.label: Range type code (existing vegetation classification), Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Range type code (existing vegetation classification), Rocky Mountain Research Station. For each nonforest condition, a code indicating the predominant existing vegetation type that is most representative of the condition.

guide.label: Reserved status code
guide.text: Reserved status code. (core for accessible forest land; core optional for other sampled land) A code indicating the reserved status of the condition on publicly owned land.

plain.label: Reserved
plain.help: Whether the land is reserved from wood harvest by law (e.g., wilderness).

guide.label: Reserved status code field, versions 1.0-5.0
guide.text: Reserved status code field, versions 1.0-5.0. A code indicating the reserved designation for the condition at the time of the field survey.

guide.label: Stand density index maximum, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Stand density index maximum, Rocky Mountain Research Station. The maximum value for the stand density index (SDI) for a particular forest type and region, at the condition level.

guide.label: Stand density index percent, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Stand density index percent, Rocky Mountain Research Station. A relative measure of stand density for live trees (≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) on the condition, expressed as a perc entage of the maximum stand density index (SDI).

guide.label: Stand density index for the condition, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Stand density index for the condition, Rocky Mountain Research Station. An index that expresses the stand density for live trees (≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) on the condition.

guide.label: Site index base age
guide.text: Site index base age. The base age (sometimes called reference age), in years, of the site index curve used to derive site index.

plain.label: Site index base age
plain.help: Base age for the condition's site index.

guide.label: Site index base age used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator
guide.text: Site index base age used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator. The base age (sometimes called reference age), in years, of the site index curves used to derive site index.

guide.label: Site index for the condition
guide.text: Site index for the condition. This represents the average total length in feet that dominant and co-dominant trees are expected to attain in well-stocked, even-aged stands at the specified base age (SIBASE).

plain.label: Site index
plain.help: Expected height of dominant trees at the base age for the condition (from its site trees).

guide.label: Site index for the condition, used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator
guide.text: Site index for the condition, used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator. This is similar to SICOND, but is computed using the equation required by, and species allowed by, the Forest Vegetation Simulator (FVS).

guide.label: Site index equation reference code
guide.text: Site index equation reference code. This is the internal reference code for site index equations in the FIA equation library.

guide.label: Site index equation reference code used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator
guide.text: Site index equation reference code used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator. This is the internal reference code for site index equations in the FIA equation library that is used to calculate site index.

guide.label: Site index species code
guide.text: Site index species code. The species upon which the site index is based.

plain.label: Site index species
plain.help: Species the condition's site index refers to.

guide.label: Site index species code used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator
guide.text: Site index species code used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator. Site index species code used by the Forest Vegetation Simulator.

guide.label: Site productivity class code
guide.text: Site productivity class code. A code indicating the classification of forest land in terms of inherent capacity to grow crops of industrial wood.

plain.label: Site class
plain.help: Productivity class: how many cubic feet of wood per acre per year the land can grow, in classes.

guide.label: Site productivity class code estimated
guide.text: Site productivity class code estimated. This is a field-recorded code that is an estimated or predicted indicator of site productivity.

guide.label: Site class method
guide.text: Site class method. A code identifying the method for determining site index or estimated site productivity class.

guide.label: Site tree tree number
guide.text: Site tree tree number. If an individual site index tree is used to calculate SICOND, this is the tree number of the site tree (SITETREE.TREE column) used.

guide.label: Condition percent slope
guide.text: Condition percent slope. The predominant or average angle of the slope across the condition to the nearest 1 percent.

plain.label: Slope
plain.help: Slope of the condition, in percent.

guide.label: Soil proportion unadjusted
guide.text: Soil proportion unadjusted. The unadjusted proportion of the soils sample that is in the condition.

guide.label: Soil rooting depth, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Soil rooting depth, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code indicating the soil depth (the depth to which tree roots can penetrate) within each forest land condition class.

guide.label: Stand structure (Maine), Northeastern Research Station
guide.text: Stand structure (Maine), Northeastern Research Station. A code indicating the basic stand structure of the trees in the condition.

guide.label: Stand structure, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Stand structure, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the description of the predominant canopy structure for the condition.

guide.label: State code
guide.text: State code. Bureau of the Census Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) 2-digit code for each State.

guide.label: Stand age
guide.text: Stand age. For annual inventories (PLOT.MANUAL ≥1.0), stand age is equal to the fie ld-recorded stand age (FLDAGE) with some exceptions: • When FLDAGE = 999, tree cores are first sent to the office for the counting of rings.

plain.label: Stand age
plain.help: Average age of the main trees in the stand, from cores or field records.

guide.label: Stand origin code
guide.text: Stand origin code. A code indicating the method of stand regeneration for the trees in the condition.

guide.label: Stand origin species code
guide.text: Stand origin species code. The species code for the predominant artificially regenerated species (only populated when STDORGCD = 1).

guide.label: Stand-size class code
guide.text: Stand-size class code. A classification of the predominant (based on stocking) diameter class of live trees within the condition assigned using an algorithm.

plain.label: Stand size class
plain.help: Predominant tree size in the condition: large diameter, medium diameter, small diameter, or nonstocked.

guide.label: Stand condition code, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Stand condition code, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code that best describes the condition of the stand within forest condition classes.

guide.label: Stand structure code, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Stand structure code, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code indicating the overall structure of the stand.

guide.label: Stump code, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Stump code, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code indicating whether or not stumps are present on a condition.

guide.label: Inventory subcycle number
guide.text: Inventory subcycle number. See SURVEY.SUBCYCLE description for definition.

guide.label: Subplot proportion unadjusted
guide.text: Subplot proportion unadjusted. The unadjusted proportion of the subplots that are in the condition.

guide.text: Trees present on nonforest, North Central Research Station.

guide.text: Crown light exposure code. (core optional on Phase 2 plots; core on Phase 3 plots only) A code indicating the amount of light being received by the tree crown.

guide.label: Sequence number
guide.text: Sequence number. A unique sequence number used to identify a tree record.

guide.label: Condition class number
guide.text: Condition class number. The unique identifying number assigned to a condition on which the tree is located, and is defined in the COND table.

plain.label: Condition
plain.help: Which condition (part of the plot with uniform land use and forest type) the record falls in.

guide.label: Cone presence code 1
guide.text: Cone presence code 1. A code indicating the type of cone presence on a live pinyon pine species ≥5.0 inches d.r.c.

guide.label: Cone presence code 2
guide.text: Cone presence code 2. See CONEPRESCD1 description for definition.

guide.label: Cone presence code 3
guide.text: Cone presence code 3. See CONEPRESCD1 description for definition.

guide.label: Length of measured core, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Length of measured core, Pacific Northwest Research Station. The total length, in inches, of the extracted core used when the tree age is extrapolated.

guide.label: County code
guide.text: County code. The identification number for a county, parish, watershed, borough, or similar governmental unit in a State.

guide.label: Crown position code
guide.text: Crown position code. (core on Phase 3 plots only) The relative position of each tree in relation to the overstory canopy.

guide.label: Compacted crown ratio
guide.text: Compacted crown ratio. The percent of the tree bole supporting live, healthy foliage (the crown is ocularly compacted to fill in gaps) when compared to actual length (ACTUALHT).

plain.label: Crown ratio
plain.help: Percent of the tree's length that carries live foliage (gaps in the crown are visually closed up).

guide.label: Created by
guide.text: Created by. See SURVEY.CREATED_BY description for definition.

guide.label: Created date
guide.text: Created date. See SURVEY.CREATED_DATE description for definition.

guide.label: Created in instance
guide.text: Created in instance. See SURVEY.CREATED_IN_INSTANCE description for definition.

guide.label: Rotten and missing cull
guide.text: Rotten and missing cull. The percent of the cubic-foot volume in a live or dead tally tree that is rotten or missing.

guide.label: Board-foot cull
guide.text: Board-foot cull. The percent of the gross board-foot volume that is cull due to rot or form.

guide.label: Cubic-foot cull
guide.text: Cubic-foot cull. The percent of the gross cubic-foot volume that is cull due to rot or form.

guide.label: Dead cull
guide.text: Dead cull. The percentage of cubic-foot volume in the merchantable bole that is cull due to sound dead material.

guide.label: Form cull
guide.text: Form cull. The percentage of cubic-foot volume in the sawlog portion that is cull due to form defect.

guide.label: Missing top cull
guide.text: Missing top cull. The percentage of cubic-foot volume that is cull due to a missing (broken) merchantable top.

guide.label: Rotten/missing board-foot cull of the sawlog
guide.text: Rotten/missing board-foot cull of the sawlog. The percent of volume within the recorded sawlog length (SAWHT) that cannot be used to produce boards, because of rot or missing sections of the bole.

guide.label: Rotten/missing board-foot cull of the sawlog code
guide.text: Rotten/missing board-foot cull of the sawlog code. A code indicating if the CULL_BF_ROTTEN attribute is not null.

guide.label: Rough board-foot cull of the sawlog
guide.text: Rough board-foot cull of the sawlog. The percent of volume within the recorded sawlog length (SAWHT) that cannot be used to produce boards, because of sweep, crook, excessive branches (e.g., whorls), large limbs and other defects.

guide.label: Rough board-foot cull of the sawlog code
guide.text: Rough board-foot cull of the sawlog code. A code indicating if the CULL_BF_ROUGH attribute is not null.

guide.label: Rotten/missing cull, field recorded
guide.text: Rotten/missing cull, field recorded. (core: ≥5.0-inch live trees; core optional: ≥5.0-inch standing dead trees) The percentage rotten or missing cubic-foot cull volume, estimated to the nearest 1 percent.

guide.label: Culturally killed code, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Culturally killed code, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code indicating if a cut tree was killed by direct human intervention, but not utilized (removed from plot).

guide.label: Crown vigor code (sapling)
guide.text: Crown vigor code (sapling). (core optional on Phase 2 plots; core on Phase 3 plots only) A code indicating the vigor of sapling crowns.

guide.label: Inventory cycle number
guide.text: Inventory cycle number. See SURVEY.CYCLE description for definition.

guide.label: Damage agent code 1
guide.text: Damage agent code 1. (core: all live tally trees ≥5.0 inches d.b.h./d.r.c; core optional: all live tally trees ≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) A code indicating the first damage agent recorded by the field crew when inspecting the tree from bottom to top (roots, bole, branches, foliage).

plain.label: Damage agent 1
plain.help: Main damage agent seen on the tree (insect, disease, abiotic and others), coded from the national damage list.

guide.label: Damage agent code 1 (Caribbean Islands), Southern Research Station
guide.text: Damage agent code 1 (Caribbean Islands), Southern Research Station. A code indicating the first damage agent observed when inspecting the tree from bottom to top (roots, bole, branches, foliage).

guide.label: Damage agent code 2
guide.text: Damage agent code 2. (core: all live tally trees ≥5.0 inches d.b.h./d.r.c; core optional: all live tally trees ≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) See DAMAGE_AGENT_CD1.

plain.label: Damage agent 2
plain.help: Second damage agent recorded on the tree.

guide.label: Damage agent code 2 (Caribbean Islands), Southern Research Station
guide.text: Damage agent code 2 (Caribbean Islands), Southern Research Station. See DAMAGE_AGENT_CD1_SRS.

guide.label: Damage agent code 3
guide.text: Damage agent code 3. (core: all live tally trees ≥5.0 inches d.b.h./d.r.c; core optional: all live tally trees ≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) See DAMAGE_AGENT_CD1.

plain.label: Damage agent 3
plain.help: Third damage agent recorded on the tree.

guide.label: Damage agent code 3 (Caribbean Islands), Southern Research Station
guide.text: Damage agent code 3 (Caribbean Islands), Southern Research Station. See DAMAGE_AGENT_CD1_SRS.

guide.label: Damage location 1
guide.text: Damage location 1. (core where PLOT.MANUAL = 1.0 through 1.6; core optional beginning with PLOT.MANUAL = 1.7) A code indicating where damage (meeting or exceeding a severity threshold, as defined in the field guide) is present on the tree.

guide.label: Damage location 1, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage location 1, Pacific Northwest Research Station. The location on the tree where Damage Agent 1 is found.

guide.label: Damage location 2
guide.text: Damage location 2. (core where PLOT.MANUAL = 1.0 through 1.6; core optional beginning with PLOT.MANUAL = 1.7) A code indicating where secondary damage (meeting or exceeding a severity threshold, as defined in the field guide) is present.

guide.label: Damage location 2, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage location 2, Pacific Northwest Research Station. See DAMLOC1_PNWRS. Only populated by certain FIA work units (SURVEY.RS CD = 26).

guide.label: Damage severity 1
guide.text: Damage severity 1. (core where PLOT.MANUAL = 1.0 through 1.6; core optional beginning with PLOT.MANUAL = 1.7) A code indicating how much of the tree is affected.

guide.label: Damage severity 2
guide.text: Damage severity 2. (core where PLOT.MANUAL = 1.0 through 1.6; core optional beginning with PLOT.MANUAL = 1.7) A code indicating how much of the tree is affected by the secondary damage.

guide.label: Damage type 1
guide.text: Damage type 1. (core where PLOT.MANUAL = 1.0 through 1.6; core optional beginning with PLOT.MANUAL = 1.7) A code indicating the kind of damage (meeting or exceeding a severity threshold, as defined in the field guide) present.

guide.label: Damage type 2
guide.text: Damage type 2. (core where PLOT.MANUAL = 1.0 through 1.6; core optional beginning with PLOT.MANUAL = 1.7) A code indicating the kind of secondary damage (meeting or exceeding a severity threshold, as defined in the field guide) present.

guide.label: Decay class code
guide.text: Decay class code. A code indicating the stage of decay in a standing dead tree (STANDING_DEAD_CD = 1).

plain.label: Decay class
plain.help: Stage of decay of a standing dead tree, from 1 (recently dead) to 5 (advanced decay).

guide.label: Current diameter
guide.text: Current diameter. The current diameter, in inches, of the sample tree at the point of diameter measurement.

plain.label: Diameter (DBH)
plain.help: Trunk diameter, in inches, at the point of measurement, normally breast height (4.5 ft above the ground).

guide.label: Diameter check code
guide.text: Diameter check code. A code indicating the reliability of the diameter measurement.

guide.label: Diameter check, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Diameter check, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A separate estimate of the diameter without the obstruction if the diameter was estimated because of moss/vine/obstruction, etc.

guide.label: Diameter height code
guide.text: Diameter height code. A code indicating the location at which diameter was measured.

plain.label: Diameter height
plain.help: Where the diameter was measured: at breast height or at the root collar.

guide.label: Standing dead estimated diameter, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Standing dead estimated diameter, Pacific Northwest Research Station. An estimate of the diameter at breast height for a standing dead tree when it was alive.

guide.label: Dieback severity, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Dieback severity, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the severity of hardwood crown dieback.

guide.label: Disease, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Disease, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the incidence of fusiform, comandra rust or dieback.

guide.label: Horizontal distance
guide.text: Horizontal distance. This attribute now available from the FIA Spatial Data Services (SDS) gr oup by following the instructions provided at th e following web address: https://www.fs.usd.gov/research/programs/fia/sds.

guide.label: Damage agent 1, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage agent 1, Pacific Northwest Research Station.

guide.label: Damage agent 2, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage agent 2, Pacific Northwest Research Station. See DMG_AGENT1_CD_PNWRS. Only populated by certain FIA work units (SURVEY.RS CD = 26).

guide.label: Damage agent 3, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage agent 3, Pacific Northwest Research Station. See DMG_AGENT1_CD_PNWRS. Only populated by certain FIA work units (SURVEY.RS CD = 26).

guide.label: Aboveground dry biomass of wood and bark
guide.text: Aboveground dry biomass of wood and bark. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of wood and bark in the aboveground portion, excluding foliage, of live and standing dead trees ≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.

plain.label: Aboveground biomass
plain.help: Oven-dry weight, in pounds, of the wood and bark above ground (foliage excluded).

guide.label: Belowground dry biomass
guide.text: Belowground dry biomass. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of the belowground portion of a tree, including coarse roots with a root diameter ≥0.1 inch.

guide.label: Dry biomass of wood in the merchantable bole
guide.text: Dry biomass of wood in the merchantable bole. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of wood in the merchantable bole of timber species (trees where diameter is measured at breast height [d.b.h.]) ≥5.0 inches d.b.h., f rom a 1-foot stump to a minimum 4-inch top diameter.

guide.label: Dry biomass of bark in the merchantable bole
guide.text: Dry biomass of bark in the merchantable bole. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of bark in the merchantable bole of timber species (trees where diameter is measured at breast height [d.b.h.]) ≥5.0 inches d.b.h., from a 1-foot stump to a minimum 4-inch top diameter.

guide.label: Dry biomass of branches
guide.text: Dry biomass of branches. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of wood and bark in the branches/limbs of timber species (trees where diameter is measured at breast height [d.b.h.]) ≥1.0 inch d.b.h.

guide.label: Dry biomass of foliage
guide.text: Dry biomass of foliage. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of foliage for live trees ≥1.0 inc h d.b.h./d.r.c.

guide.label: Dry biomass of wood in the sawlog portion of a sawtimber tree
guide.text: Dry biomass of wood in the sawlog portion of a sawtimber tree.

guide.label: Dry biomass of bark in the sawlog portion of a sawtimber tree
guide.text: Dry biomass of bark in the sawlog portion of a sawtimber tree.

guide.label: Dry biomass of wood in the total stem
guide.text: Dry biomass of wood in the total stem. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of wood in the total stem of timber species (trees where diameter is measured at breast height [d.b.h.]) ≥1.0 inch d.b.h., from ground line to the tree tip.

guide.label: Dry biomass of bark in the total stem
guide.text: Dry biomass of bark in the total stem. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of bark in the total stem of timber species (trees where diameter is measured at breast height [d.b.h.]) ≥1.0 inch d.b.h., from ground line to the tree tip.

guide.label: Dry biomass of wood in the stump
guide.text: Dry biomass of wood in the stump. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of wood in the stump of timber species (trees where diameter is measured at breast height [d.b.h.]) ≥5.0 in ches d.b.h.

guide.label: Dry biomass of bark in the stump
guide.text: Dry biomass of bark in the stump. The oven-dry biomass, in pounds, of bark in the stump of timber species (trees where diameter is measured at breast height [d.b.h.]) ≥5.0 inc hes d.b.h.

guide.label: Epiphyte loading (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Epiphyte loading (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station. A rating indicating the extent of epiphyte loading.

guide.label: Form class
guide.text: Form class. A code used in calculating merchantable bole net volume.

guide.label: Growth sample tree, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Growth sample tree, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code indicating whether or not a tree is to be measured for total length and actual length and used as a growth sample tree.

guide.label: Hardwood clump code
guide.text: Hardwood clump code. A code sequentially assigned to each hardwood clump within each species as they are found on a subplot.

guide.label: Total height
guide.text: Total height. (All live and standing dead tally trees ≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) The total length (height) of a tree, in feet, from the ground to the tip of the apical meristem beginning in PLOT.MANUAL = 1.1.

plain.label: Total height
plain.help: Height of the tree from the ground to the top, in feet; for broken tops, the estimated unbroken height.

guide.label: Current height calculated
guide.text: Current height calculated. If the height is unmeasurable (e.g., the tree is cut or dead), the height is calculated, in feet, and stored in this attribute.

guide.label: Height method code
guide.text: Height method code.

plain.label: Height method
plain.help: How the height was obtained: measured, estimated, or modeled.

guide.label: Height to diameter measurement point
guide.text: Height to diameter measurement point. This value is equal to the actual length, to the nearest 0.1 foot, from ground to the point of diameter measurement.

guide.label: 10-year increment, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: 10-year increment, Pacific Northwest Research Station. The radial increment for the most recent ten years of full growth for all conifers and red alder.

guide.label: 5-year height growth, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: 5-year height growth, Pacific Northwest Research Station. The height to the nearest 1.0 foot, for the most recent five years of growth for pine, spruce, Douglas-fir, and true firs.

guide.label: 5-year increment, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: 5-year increment, Pacific Northwest Research Station. The radial increment for the most recent five years of full growth for all conifers and red alder.

guide.label: Inventory year
guide.text: Inventory year. See SURVEY.INVYR description for definition.

guide.label: Mast code
guide.text: Mast code. A rating indicating the amount of masting for a live pinyon pine species ≥5.0 inc hes d.r.c.

guide.label: Mistletoe class code
guide.text: Mistletoe class code.

guide.label: Leafy mistletoe class code, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Leafy mistletoe class code, Pacific Northwest Research Station. All juniper species, incense cedars, white fir (CA only) and oak trees are rated for leafy mistletoe infection.

guide.label: Modified by
guide.text: Modified by. See SURVEY.MODIFIED_BY description for definition.

guide.label: Modified date
guide.text: Modified date. See SURVEY.MODIFIED_DATE description for definition.

guide.label: Modified in instance
guide.text: Modified in instance. See SURVEY.MODIFIED_IN_INSTANCE description for definition.

guide.label: Mortality code
guide.text: Mortality code. (core optional) Used for a tree that was alive within past 5 years, but has died.

guide.label: Mortality year
guide.text: Mortality year. (core optional) The estimated year in which a remeasured tree died or was cut.

plain.label: Year of death
plain.help: Estimated year a remeasured tree died or was cut.

guide.label: Periodic to annual growth, removal, and mortality flag
guide.text: Periodic to annual growth, removal, and mortality flag. A code indicating if this tree is part of a periodic inventory that is only included for the purposes of computing growth, removals and/or mortality estimates.

plain.label: Bridge record
plain.help: Y = record linking the older periodic design to the current one (periodic-to-annual growth, removal and mortality); not a tallied tree.

guide.label: Plot number
guide.text: Plot number. An identifier for a plot.

guide.label: Plot sequence number
guide.text: Plot sequence number. Foreign key linking the tree record to the plot record.

guide.label: Previous condition class number
guide.text: Previous condition class number. This Identifies the condition within the plot on which the tree occurred at the previous inventory.

guide.label: Previous diameter
guide.text: Previous diameter. The previous diameter, in inches, of the sample tree at the point of diameter measurement.

guide.label: Previous diameter, field
guide.text: Previous diameter, field. The previous diameter, in inches, of the sample tree at the point of diameter measurement, if the value was updated by the current field crew.

guide.label: Previous actual height
guide.text: Previous actual height. (All live and standing dead tally trees ≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) The actual height measured in the field from the previous inventory.

guide.label: Previous radial growth and tree age check code, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Previous radial growth and tree age check code, Rocky Mountain Research Station. A code indicating the method used to obtain radial growth and tree age assigned at the previous inventory (from annual or periodic data).

guide.label: Previous breast height age, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Previous breast height age, Rocky Mountain Research Station. The breast height age (BHAGE) assigned to a tree at the previous inventory (from annual or periodic data).

guide.label: Previous total height
guide.text: Previous total height. (All live and standing dead tally trees ≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) The total height from the previous inventory (HTCD = 1, 2, or 3).

guide.label: Previous periodic prism point, tree number, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Previous periodic prism point, tree number, Southern Research Station. In some older Southeast Experiment Station States, the prism point, tree number (PNTN) of the current cycle did not match the previous cycle's prism point, tree number.

guide.label: Previous tree status code
guide.text: Previous tree status code. Tree status that was recorded at the previous inventory on all tally trees ≥1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.

guide.label: Previous total age, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Previous total age, Rocky Mountain Research Station. The total age assigned to a tree at the previous inventory (from annual or periodic data).

guide.label: Previous tree class code, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Previous tree class code, Rocky Mountain Research Station. The tree class (TREECLCD_RMRS) assigned at the previous inventory (from annual or periodic data).

guide.label: Previous tree sequence number
guide.text: Previous tree sequence number. Foreign key linking the tree to the previous inventory's tree record for this tree.

guide.label: Previous woodland stem count
guide.text: Previous woodland stem count. Woodland tree species stem count that was recorded at the previous inventory.

guide.label: Radial growth / age code, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Radial growth / age code, Rocky Mountain Research Station. A code indicating if growth and/or age information is required for the tree.

guide.label: Radial growth, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Radial growth, Rocky Mountain Research Station. A 2-digit number indicating the length of a 10-year radial increment for trees that require radial growth information to be collected (see RADAGECD_RMRS for radial growth and age tree selection guidelines).

guide.label: Reconcile code
guide.text: Reconcile code. A code indicating the reason a tree either enters or is no longer a part of the inventory.

plain.label: Reason entered/left
plain.help: Why a tree entered the tally (e.g., 1 = ingrowth, 3 = moved microplot) or left it (e.g., 8 = moved microplot).

guide.label: WRS Number of rings in inner 2 inches, Pacific Northwest Research Station NUMBER(3) 3.1.169 RING_COUNT_PNWRS Number of rings, Pacific Northwest Rese arch Station NUMBER(3) 3.1.170 SNAG_DIS_CD_PNWRS Snag reason for disappearance code, Pacific Northwest Research Station NUMBER(1) 3.1.171 CONEPRESCD1 Cone presence code 1…
guide.text: WRS Number of rings in inner 2 inches, Pacific Northwest Research Station NUMBER(3) 3.1.169 RING_COUNT_PNWRS Number of rings, Pacific Northwest Rese arch Station NUMBER(3) 3.1.170 SNAG_DIS_CD_PNWRS Snag reason for disappearance code, Pacific Northwest Research Station NUMBER(1) 3.1.171 CONEPRESCD1 Cone presence code 1…

guide.label: Number of rings in inner 2 inches, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Number of rings in inner 2 inches, Pacific Northwest Research Station. The number of tree rings in the inner two inches of the core closest to the center of the tree.

guide.label: Number of rings, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Number of rings, Pacific Northwest Research Station. The total number of tree rings counted when the tree age is extrapolated.

guide.label: Rooting height (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Rooting height (Pacific Islands), Pacific Northwest Research Station. The height of the stilted or buttressed root system from the ground level to the highest point where the stilts or buttresses protrude from the bole of the tree.

guide.label: Rough cull
guide.text: Rough cull. (core optional) The percentage of cubic-foot volume in the merchantable bole that is cull due to sound dead material or tree form.

guide.label: Salvable dead code
guide.text: Salvable dead code. A code indicating whether or not a standing or down dead tree is salvable based on regional standards.

guide.label: Sapling fusiform, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Sapling fusiform, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the incidence of fusiform occurring on the main stem or on a live branch within 12 inches of the main stem of longleaf, slash, and loblolly pine saplings (STATUSCD = 1 and SPCD = 11, 121, or 131 and 1 ≤ DIA <5).

guide.label: Sawlog height
guide.text: Sawlog height. The length (height) of a tree, recorded to a 7-inch top (9-inch for hardwoods), where at least one 8-foot log, merchantable or not, is present.

guide.label: Damage severity 1A, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage severity 1A, Pacific Northwest Research Station. Damage severity depends on the damage agent coded (see appendix I for codes).

guide.label: Damage severity 1B, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage severity 1B, Pacific Northwest Research Station. Damage severity B is only coded when the Damage Agent is white pine blister rust (36).

guide.label: Damage severity 1, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage severity 1, Pacific Northwest Research Station. Damage severity depends on the damage agent coded (see appendix I for codes).

guide.label: Damage severity 2A, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage severity 2A, Pacific Northwest Research Station. See SEVERITY1A_CD_PNWRS. Only populated by certain FIA work units (SURVEY.RS CD = 26).

guide.label: Damage severity 2B, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage severity 2B, Pacific Northwest Research Station. See SEVERITY1B_CD_PNWRS. Only populated by certain FIA work units (SURVEY.RS CD = 26).

guide.label: Damage severity 2, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage severity 2, Pacific Northwest Research Station. Damage severity depends on the damage agent coded (see appendix I for codes).

guide.label: Damage severity 3, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Damage severity 3, Pacific Northwest Research Station. Damage severity depends on the damage agent coded (see appendix I for codes).

guide.label: Calculated site index
guide.text: Calculated site index. Computed for every tree.

guide.label: Snag reason for disappearance code, Pacific Northwest Research Station
guide.text: Snag reason for disappearance code, Pacific Northwest Research Station. A code indicating the reason why a standing dead tree recorded during a previous inventory visit is no longer tallied.

guide.label: Species code
guide.text: Species code. An FIA tree species code.

plain.label: Species
plain.help: Tree species code (SPCD); the name comes from the REF_SPECIES table.

guide.label: Species identification code
guide.text: Species identification code. An optional code indicating the method for species identification.

guide.label: Species group code
guide.text: Species group code. A code assigned to each tree species to group them for reporting purposes.

guide.label: Standing dead code
guide.text: Standing dead code. A code indicating if a tree qualifies as standing dead.

plain.label: Standing dead
plain.help: Whether a dead tree qualifies as standing dead (used for dead-wood estimates).

guide.label: State code
guide.text: State code. Bureau of the Census Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) 2-digit code for each State.

guide.label: Status code
guide.text: Status code. A code indicating whether the sample tree is live, cut, or dead at the time of measurement.

plain.label: Status
plain.help: Whether the tree is live (1), standing dead (2) or cut (3) at this measurement; 0 = no longer in the sample.

guide.label: Tree stocking
guide.text: Tree stocking. The stocking value, in percent, computed for each live tree.

guide.label: Inventory subcycle number
guide.text: Inventory subcycle number. See SURVEY.SUBCYCLE description for definition.

guide.label: Subplot number
guide.text: Subplot number. The number assigned to the subplot.

plain.label: Subplot
plain.help: Subplot number (1 = center, 2 = north, 3 = southeast, 4 = southwest on the national design; higher numbers are periodic points or bridge records).

guide.label: Total age
guide.text: Total age.

guide.label: Trees per acre unadjusted
guide.text: Trees per acre unadjusted. The number of trees per acre that the sample tree theoretically represents based on the sample design.

plain.label: Trees per acre represented
plain.help: How many trees per acre this one sample tree stands for, based on the plot size it was measured on (about 6 for subplot trees, about 75 for microplot saplings).

guide.label: Foliage transparency code
guide.text: Foliage transparency code. (core optional on Phase 2 plots; core on Phase 3 plots only) A code indicating the amount of light penetrating the foliated portion of the crown, estimated in percent classes.

guide.label: Tree number
guide.text: Tree number. A number used to uniquely identify a tree on a subplot.

plain.label: Tree number
plain.help: Number identifying the tree on its subplot.

guide.label: Tree class code
guide.text: Tree class code.

plain.label: Tree class
plain.help: Whether the tree is growing stock (could yield wood products) or a rough or rotten cull.

guide.label: Tree class code (version 3.1), Northeastern Research Station
guide.text: Tree class code (version 3.1), Northeastern Research Station. A classification of the general quality of a tree that is ≥5.0 inches d.b.h.

guide.label: Tree class code, North Central Research Station
guide.text: Tree class code, North Central Research Station. In annual inventory, a code indicating tree suitability for timber products, or the extent of decay in the butt section of down-dead trees.

guide.label: Tree class code, Northeastern Research Station
guide.text: Tree class code, Northeastern Research Station. In annual inventory, this code represents a classification of the overall quality of a tree that is ≥5.0 inches d.b. h.

guide.label: Tree class code, Rocky Mountain Research Station
guide.text: Tree class code, Rocky Mountain Research Station. A code indicating the general quality of the tree.

guide.label: Tree class code, Southern Research Station
guide.text: Tree class code, Southern Research Station. A code indicating the general quality of the tree.

guide.label: Tree grade code
guide.text: Tree grade code. A code indicating the quality of sawtimber trees.

guide.label: Tree history code
guide.text: Tree history code. Identifies the tree with detailed information as to whether the tree is live, dead, cut, removed due to land use change, etc.

guide.label: Tree grade, North Central Research Station
guide.text: Tree grade, North Central Research Station. A 3-digit code indicating the quality of sawtimber-sized trees that have a TREECLCD_NCRS of 20 or 31.
