meta.source: FIADB User Guide, Volume: Database Description, version 9.4 (August 2025)
meta.how: Plain-English text is written from the User Guide wording and cites its section numbers (§). Where the guide does not define something, the text says so. Values computed by this site (per-acre totals, growth, events) cite the guide columns they are computed from.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.intro: Short statements generated from this plot's data: the first and last values, peaks and the largest changes.

timeline.title: Visit timeline
timeline.intro: Each card is one visit (survey) to this plot location. FIA returns to the same plot and remeasures the same trees; REMPER is the number of years between measurements.

predecessor.title: Inferred predecessor
predecessor.intro: Plots of the older periodic design are not linked to the current plots in the database (PREV_PLT_CN does not link to a periodic record). This site lists nearby periodic plots that probably stood on the same ground, scored by distance, dates and matching tree records. They are inferences, not database links.

survey.title: Survey summary
survey.intro: One row per survey with per-acre totals for live trees. Each measured tree is multiplied by the number of trees per acre it represents (TPA_UNADJ) and the results are added up.

treetot.title: Tree totals
treetot.intro: Counts of the trees actually measured at each survey, before per-acre expansion, and how many died, grew into the tally or were added since the previous survey.

details.title: Visit details
details.intro: All records collected at the selected visit, grouped by FIADB table. Pick a visit on the timeline to change it.

cond.title: Conditions
cond.intro: A condition is an area of the plot that is uniform in land use, forest type, stand size, ownership and similar attributes. Most plots have one condition; some are split. CONDPROP_UNADJ is the share of the plot in each condition.

metrics.title: Stand metrics
metrics.intro: Totals for this visit computed from the tree records: live and standing-dead trees ≥1.0 in on subplots 1–4, expanded to per-acre values.

species_v.title: Species at this visit
species_v.intro: Live and standing-dead trees at this visit summarized by species.

trees.title: Trees
trees.intro: Every tree record at this visit: one row per measured tree with its diameter, height, status and codes. Records on subplots numbered above 4 are bridge records linking the older periodic design to the current one and are not counted in totals.

seed.title: Seedlings
seed.intro: Live seedlings (trees under 1.0 in diameter) are counted by species on the small microplots, not measured individually. TPA_UNADJ is the number of seedlings per acre a count represents.

site.title: Site trees
site.intro: Trees chosen to measure how productive the land is. The crew measures a dominant or co-dominant tree's height and age (AGEDIA, age at breast height); from those, site index is the expected height of dominant trees at a base age (SIBASE). One or a few per forest condition is normal, and they are not remeasured at every visit.

veg.title: P2 vegetation
veg.intro: Canopy cover of plant growth habits (trees, shrubs, forbs, grasses) by height layer, estimated on each subplot. Only part of the plots are sampled.

inv.title: Invasives
inv.intro: Invasive plant species from a regional list, recorded with their canopy cover on each subplot. Only part of the plots and visits are surveyed; INVASIVE_SAMPLING_STATUS_CD says whether this visit was.

dwm.title: Down woody material
dwm.intro: Dead wood and fuels on the ground (fallen logs, fine woody debris, litter, duff and piles), sampled along transects on a subset of plots.

soils.title: Soils
soils.intro: Forest floor and mineral soil samples and their lab results from the older soil program. These SOILS_* tables are not described in the v9.4 User Guide; where a column has the same name in the v9.4 soil tables, that description is shown.

plotrec.title: PLOT record
plotrec.intro: Every field of the PLOT row for this visit: when and how the plot was measured and which design was used.

vc.title: Volume and carbon
vc.intro: Net cubic-foot stem wood volume (trees ≥5.0 in) and aboveground carbon in wood and bark (all live trees ≥1.0 in), per acre, stacked by species.

species.title: Species
species.intro: Live basal area per acre by species at each survey. Basal area is the cross-section area of the trunks at breast height, a common measure of how much tree there is.

comp.title: Species composition
comp.intro: Each bar is one survey; segments show each species group's share of live basal area, so every bar adds to 100%.

indiv.title: Individual trees
indiv.intro: Each measured tree is followed through the surveys using its link to the previous record (PREV_TRE_CN). Panels show diameter over time by species; the table lists every tree.

growth.title: Growth
growth.intro: Diameter growth of trees that were alive at two consecutive surveys: the change in diameter divided by the years between the survey dates.

mort.title: Mortality
mort.intro: Trees alive at one survey and recorded dead at the next, by interval and cause of death (AGENTCD).

invh.title: Invasives by survey
invh.intro: Invasive plant species recorded at each surveyed visit.

caveats.title: Caveats for this plot
caveats.intro: Limits of the numbers on this page that apply to this plot. General caveats are on the About page.

xmap.title: Expert filters
xmap.intro: Filters and marker colours from each plot's latest visit: PLOT fields (P2PANEL, CYCLE, KINDCD, DESIGNCD, PLOT_STATUS_CD, nonsampled reason) and its largest condition (STDSZCD, GSSTKCD, SITECLCD, disturbance and treatment codes). The expected next measurement is estimated from the plot's own past national-design intervals; it is not an FIA schedule.

survey.label: Survey
survey.help: Survey date (MEASYEAR, MEASMON, MEASDAY). Periodic visits often record only the month.

invyr.label: Inventory year
invyr.help: Inventory year (INVYR): the year the data are assigned to; it can differ from the measurement year.

design.label: Design
design.help: Plot design: national design (annual inventory, four 24-ft subplots with 6.8-ft microplots) or an older periodic design.

age.label: Stand age
age.help: Stand age of the condition, as recorded in COND.STDAGE.

fortyp.label: Forest type
fortyp.help: Forest type of the largest forest condition (COND.FORTYPCD), the type used for reporting.

tpa5.label: Trees/ac ≥5 in
tpa5.help: Live trees 5.0 in diameter or larger, per acre: the sum of their TPA_UNADJ.

sap.label: Saplings/ac
sap.help: Live saplings 1.0–4.9 in diameter per acre, counted on the microplots.

tpa.label: Trees/ac
tpa.help: Live trees ≥1.0 in per acre (TPA): the sum of TPA_UNADJ of the live trees.

ba.label: Basal area
ba.help: Live basal area per acre: for each live tree, 0.005454 × DIA² (ft² of trunk cross-section at breast height) × TPA_UNADJ, summed.

qmd.label: QMD
qmd.help: Quadratic mean diameter: the diameter of the tree of average basal area, √(Σ DIA² × TPA ÷ Σ TPA), live trees ≥1.0 in.

vol.label: Net volume
vol.help: Net cubic-foot stem wood volume per acre (VOLCFNET × TPA_UNADJ), live trees ≥5.0 in.

c.label: Carbon
c.help: Aboveground carbon in wood and bark per acre: CARBON_AG (pounds) × TPA_UNADJ ÷ 2,000.

dead_new.label: Dead trees (new)
dead_new.help: Standing-dead trees tallied at the survey; in brackets, trees newly recorded dead since the previous survey (and trees cut).

newtrees.label: New trees
newtrees.help: Trees that grew into the tally since the previous survey (ingrowth, RECONCILECD 1); * marks other additions such as a microplot move (RECONCILECD 3).

n_live.label: Live trees
n_live.help: Number of live tree records tallied (subplots 1–4), not expanded to per-acre values.

n5.label: of which ≥5 in
n5.help: Live tree records 5.0 in diameter or larger.

nsap.label: Saplings
nsap.help: Live tree records 1.0–4.9 in diameter (measured on the microplots).

dead_tpa.label: Dead trees/ac
dead_tpa.help: Standing-dead trees per acre: the sum of their TPA_UNADJ.

newly_dead.label: Newly dead
newly_dead.help: Trees alive at the previous survey, or first tallied, and recorded dead at this one.

ingrowth.label: Ingrowth
ingrowth.help: Trees that grew into the tally since the previous survey (RECONCILECD 1).

added.label: Other additions
added.help: Trees added for other reasons, such as a moved microplot or a tree missed before (RECONCILECD 2–4).

species.label: Species
species.help: Tree species (SPCD) with its common name from the REF_SPECIES table.

pct_ba.label: % of BA
pct_ba.help: This species' share of the live basal area at that survey.

vol_y.label: Volume
vol_y.help: Net cubic-foot stem wood volume per acre for the species at that survey.

c_y.label: Carbon
c_y.help: Aboveground carbon per acre for the species at that survey.

ba_y.label: Basal area
ba_y.help: Live basal area per acre for the species at that survey.

tpa5_y.label: Trees/ac ≥5 in
tpa5_y.help: Live trees ≥5.0 in per acre for the species at that survey.

tree_id.label: Tree
tree_id.help: Subplot and tree number of the tree's first record (S2-T5 = subplot 2, tree 5). -P2A marks bridge records.

dbh_last.label: Latest DBH
dbh_last.help: Diameter at breast height (4.5 ft) at the tree's last record.

growth_tree.label: Growth
growth_tree.help: Mean annual diameter growth over the tree's live-to-live remeasurements.

fate.label: Status / fate
fate.help: How the tree entered the tally and its last status: live, dead (with cause), cut, or removed from the sample.

spark.label: DBH over time
spark.help: Small line of the tree's diameter at each survey.

rank.label: Rank
rank.help: Candidate rank by score (1 = best match).

pred_plot.label: Periodic plot
pred_plot.help: Location key of the candidate periodic plot.

last_measured.label: Last measured
last_measured.help: Last measurement date of the candidate periodic plot.

ft_age.label: Forest type, age
ft_age.help: Forest type and stand age of the candidate at its last measurement.

dist.label: Distance
dist.help: Distance between the public (fuzzed) coordinates of the two plots.

datefit.label: Date fit
datefit.help: Difference between the candidate's last date plus this plot's REMPER and this plot's first national-design date.

bridge.label: Bridge trees matched
bridge.help: First-visit bridge records (SUBP > 4) matched by species and diameter to the candidate's trees.

score.label: Score
score.help: Match score: bridge-tree matches (60 points), date fit (25) and distance (15). Computed by this site; not an FIA value.

n_trees.label: Trees
n_trees.help: Number of distinct trees contributing intervals.

g_range.label: Range
g_range.help: Smallest and largest annual diameter growth.

g_ht.label: Height growth
g_ht.help: Mean annual height growth where both heights were recorded.

interval.label: Interval
interval.help: The two surveys the change falls between.

cause.label: Cause
cause.help: Cause of death (AGENTCD), decoded from the User Guide.

tpa_lost.label: Trees/ac lost
tpa_lost.help: Trees per acre represented by the trees that died (their last live TPA_UNADJ).

ba_lost.label: BA lost
ba_lost.help: Basal area per acre of the trees that died, from their last live diameter.

inv_species.label: Species
inv_species.help: Invasive plant species (VEG_SPCD) with its name from REF_PLANT_DICTIONARY.

inv_symbol.label: Symbol
inv_symbol.help: PLANTS database symbol of the species.

inv_subp.label: Subplots
inv_subp.help: Subplots on which the species was recorded.

inv_cover.label: Mean cover
inv_cover.help: Mean canopy cover on the subplots where it was recorded.

ba_tree.label: BA
ba_tree.help: This tree's basal area expanded to per acre: 0.005454 × DIA² × TPA_UNADJ.

linked.label: Linked
linked.help: Whether the record has a link to the same tree's previous record (PREV_TRE_CN).

size_live.label: Live
size_live.help: Live trees per acre in the diameter class.

size_dead.label: Standing dead
size_dead.help: Standing-dead trees per acre in the diameter class.

c4.label: ≥20 in
c4.help: Trees per acre 20.0 in diameter or larger.

live_n_sp.label: Live trees
live_n_sp.help: Live tree records of the species.

dead_n_sp.label: Dead trees
dead_n_sp.help: Standing-dead tree records of the species.

dead_tpa_sp.label: Dead TPA
dead_tpa_sp.help: Standing-dead trees per acre of the species.

dist_loc.label: Distance
dist_loc.help: Distance from the point you entered to the plot's public (fuzzed) coordinates.

visits.label: Visits
visits.help: Number of surveys at this location key.

died_pop.label: Died
died_pop.help: Trees that died since the previous survey (trees tallied, not per acre).

inv_pop.label: Invasives
inv_pop.help: Number of invasive plant species recorded at the survey.

comp_group.label: Species group
comp_group.help: Species grouped by genus for the composition chart.

sdi.label: SDI (Reineke)
sdi.help: Reineke stand density index: TPA × (QMD ÷ 10)^1.605, from this visit's live trees ≥1.0 in (unadjusted per-acre values). Computed by this site; the FIADB User Guide does not define an SDI column for single plots.

dclass.label: DBH class
dclass.help: 2-inch diameter class (1.0–2.9, 3.0–4.9, 5.0–6.9 in, …) of live trees.

grm_n.label: Trees
grm_n.help: Number of TREE_GRM_COMPONENT records in the component for this interval.

grm_grow.label: Growth
grm_grow.help: Σ GROWCFAL_FOREST × SUBP_TPAGROW_UNADJ_AL_FOREST: net annual sound cubic-foot growth per acre, unadjusted, as provided by FIADB.

grm_mort.label: Mortality
grm_mort.help: Σ MORTCFAL_FOREST × SUBP_TPAMORT_UNADJ_AL_FOREST: annual sound cubic-foot mortality per acre, unadjusted, as provided by FIADB.

grm_remv.label: Removals
grm_remv.help: Σ REMVCFAL_FOREST × SUBP_TPAREMV_UNADJ_AL_FOREST: annual sound cubic-foot removals per acre, unadjusted, as provided by FIADB.

sub_n5.label: Trees ≥5 in
sub_n5.help: Live trees ≥5.0 in tallied on the subplot.

sub_nsap.label: Saplings
sub_nsap.help: Live saplings 1.0–4.9 in tallied on the subplot's microplot.

sub_tpa.label: Trees/ac (share)
sub_tpa.help: The subplot's contribution to the plot's live trees per acre (Σ TPA_UNADJ of its live trees).

sub_ba.label: BA (share)
sub_ba.help: The subplot's contribution to the plot's live basal area per acre.

sub_comp.label: Leading species
sub_comp.help: Up to three species with the most basal area on the subplot.

raw_vi.label: vi
raw_vi.help: Visit index on this page (0 = first visit at this location key). Added by this site; not an FIADB column.

raw_ti.label: ti
raw_ti.help: Tree index on this page (one per linked tree). Added by this site; not an FIADB column.

raw_pv.label: pv
raw_pv.help: 1 if the record has a PREV_TRE_CN link to an earlier record. Added by this site; not an FIADB column.

glossary.def: The cross-section area of a tree trunk at breast height (4.5 ft). For a tree it is 0.005454 × DBH² square feet; per acre it is the sum over the trees of that area times the trees per acre each tree represents.
The number of trees per acre. Each sample tree stands for TPA_UNADJ trees per acre, set by the size of the plot it was measured on; the stand's TPA is the sum of TPA_UNADJ.

The diameter of the tree of average basal area: √(Σ DBH² × TPA ÷ Σ TPA). It is larger than the plain average diameter. The User Guide uses QMD in its stocking and stand-size descriptions but does not give a column for single plots; this site computes it from the tree records.
Trunk diameter measured 4.5 ft above the ground on the uphill side (DIA). Woodland species are measured at the root collar instead.
Cubic feet of wood in the main stem of trees ≥5.0 in DBH, from a 1-ft stump to a 4-in top, after deductions for rot and missing wood (VOLCFNET). Per acre: VOLCFNET × TPA_UNADJ, summed.
Carbon in the wood and bark of the aboveground part of the tree, excluding foliage (CARBON_AG, pounds). This site reports tons per acre: CARBON_AG × TPA_UNADJ ÷ 2,000.
The expected height of dominant and co-dominant trees at a base age (often 25 or 50 years); higher means more productive land. It is calculated from site trees.
glossary.units: ft (at a base age in years)

glossary.def: Average age of the main trees in the stand. For annual inventories it equals the field-recorded age (FLDAGE) with some exceptions.
A classification of the forest by the tree species with the most stocking (e.g., loblolly pine, oak / hickory). FORTYPCD is the type used for reporting.

The national plot design has four 24-ft-radius subplots (center, north, southeast, southwest) where trees ≥5.0 in are measured, and in each a 6.8-ft-radius microplot where saplings 1.0–4.9 in and seedlings are measured. Microplot trees therefore represent many more trees per acre.
A tree that was too small to be tallied at the previous survey and has grown into the tally (RECONCILECD 1).

Reconcile code: the reason a tree entered the inventory (ingrowth, through growth, missed earlier, moved microplot, …) or is no longer part of it (cruiser error, procedural change, moved microplot, …).

Per-acre values that expand one plot's trees by their TPA_UNADJ only, without FIA's stratum adjustment factors used for state estimates. They describe this plot's sample, not an acre of forest around it, and single trees can move them a lot.

Before the annual inventory, plots were measured periodically with older designs (often variable-radius points; DESIGNCD 2xx). The national design (DESIGNCD 1) uses fixed-radius subplots and microplots.
